ruleDefinitions.name: New TimeProviders Registered With Uncommon DLL Name
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects processes setting a new DLL in DllName in under HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\W32Time\TimeProvider.
Adversaries may abuse time providers to execute DLLs when the system boots.
The Windows Time service (W32Time) enables time synchronization across and within domains.
 Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Services\\\\W32Time\\\\TimeProviders.*") AND registry_path = RGX("\\\\DllName$")) AND  NOT ((Details = "\%SystemRoot\%\\System32\\vmictimeprovider\.dll" OR Details = "\%systemroot\%\\system32\\w32time\.dll" OR Details = "C\:\\Windows\\SYSTEM32\\w32time\.DLL"))
